title: Helios workspace template
description: template.json of a .helios-template bundle: what the template is (meta), its starting network, its tools and the library it works with. Its layout is layout.json, egui-pop's layout document. See docs/templates.md.

format.description: The format the file is written in; 1 today. A Helios refuses a newer one.

id.description: Stable, never translated: lowercase words of letters and digits joined by '.' or '-' (helios.portrait-retouch).

version.description: The template's own version, bumped by its author.

parameters.description: What is asked when a workspace is created from the template (ask on create).

subworkspaces.description: Named scopes over nodes of the network (sub-workspaces), nested through 'parent'. Scopes under one parent share no node.

retired_subworkspaces.description: The ids of deleted sub-workspaces: never given again in this workspace.

positions.description: Where the graph view draws each node, by name: its top-left corner in graph units. A view, never read by the render.

name.description: The English name; translations in the bundle's i18n/<locale>/*.ftl under <slug of id>-name.

scenario.description: The scenario it is made for, in English; translations under <slug of id>-scenario.

preview.description: A picture of it: a file of the bundle.

icon.description: A short generic icon name (portrait, import), shown beside its name.

name.description: A node's name: a lowercase letter, then lowercase letters, digits and '_'.

sources.description: The images the workspace is given, by node name; each one's output port is 'image'.

raw_sources.description: The sources given a raw file's sensor data: its mosaic, one channel in raw units, the camera's description (levels, filter pattern, white balance, matrix) the context of every node reading it. The other sources are given a picture, four channels (RGBA).

image_sources.description: The sources given an image: a picture as it is, a raw file's mosaic with its camera followed by the raw front (helios.raw-front@1: levels, white balance, highlights, demosaicing, camera colours), then colour calibration from the camera's illuminant (the white balance then at the camera's D65 reference) and the camera's orientation, so what reads them gets a picture, four channels (RGBA), either way. A source is in raw_sources or image_sources, not both.

node.description: A module (by its manifest's name) or a composite (by id and version), never both.

raw_params.description: Put over params when the network is built with a raw (a raw source, or an image source given one): a raw's defaults, such as darktable's exposure for a raw (+0.7 EV, black -0.000244, the camera's exposure bias taken back).

open.description: A composite opened: its inner nodes put in the graph as <name>.<inner>, which panels edit.

bypassed.description: Rendered as if absent, its parameters kept: its output is the input it passes through.

values.description: Parameter values by node name: a module's parameters, a composite's exposed ones.

params.description: Parameter values by name, each tagged by its kind.

panel_hint.description: Which panel edits a composite and where it docks.

toolbox.description: Command ids, in the order shown.

keymap.description: Bindings added to the workspace's keymap layer.

library.description: The library the workspace works with: an import source, the images it shows, how culling goes.

auto_advance.description: Culling moves to the next image after each mark.

compare.description: The workspace opens in Compare: two or more photos side by side, the selection's until photos are chosen.

sort.description: The order the library shows the photos in; by capture time, oldest first, when absent.

export.description: How the workspace exports its images, as library.export takes them: what the export dialog starts from.

format.description: The file format; jpeg when absent.

bits.description: PNG's bits per channel (8 when absent).

long_edge.description: The longer side at most, in pixels; the full size when absent.

space.description: The colour space written; srgb when absent.

folder.description: The folder written to: absolute, or under the home folder (~/Pictures/Export); asked when absent.

pattern.description: The file names without extension, as an import's renaming writes them: {stem}, {date}-{seq}.

clash.description: A file name taken already: another name, the file replaced, or the image left out.

query.description: The images the library opens on, as the search field's criteria: all must hold (labels and flags: any of them; tags: all of them).

min_rating.description: At least this many stars, 0 to 5.

flags.description: One of these flags: picked, rejected, or neither.

import.description: An import source, as library.import takes it.

source.description: A mounted card (read from its DCIM) or a folder and its subfolders.

placement.description: Files referenced where they are, or copied into the library folder.

rename.description: A copy's new name, as helios import --rename takes it: {date}-{seq}.

duplicates.description: What to do with an exact duplicate.

suggest_stacks.description: After each import, propose stacks to review (nothing applied until accepted).

darktable.description: Keep each photo's darktable sidecars (.xmp, base and duplicates) as versions of it; true by default.

parameter.description: A value asked for when a workspace is created; without an answer the template's own value stays.

name.description: In English; translations under <slug of id>-parameter-<id>.

at.description: Where the answer goes, as a JSON pointer into template.json: /library/import/source.

subworkspace_id.description: A sub-workspace's stable id, a slug of its first name: lowercase words of letters and digits joined by '.' or '-' (skin, skin-2).

subworkspace.description: A sub-workspace: a named scope over nodes of the network; entered, it shows and edits only its nodes.

nodes.description: Every node in it, those of the sub-workspaces nested in it included: a node's name, or an opened composite's inner node (<name>.<inner>).

parent.description: The id of the sub-workspace it is nested in; at the top without one.

keys.description: As a profile writes them: Mod+Shift+P.
